description.zh: 每天 30 分钟 Anki + 一集《老友记》跟读。目标：明年裸看美剧不盯字幕，顺便把六级过了。
description.en: 30 minutes of Anki plus one episode of Friends with shadowing, every single day. Goal: watch shows without subtitles by next year — and pass CET-6 along the way.

description.zh: 回复 issue、review PR、写文档。开源最难的不是写代码，是持续在场。
description.en: Answering issues, reviewing PRs, writing docs. The hardest part of open source is showing up, not writing code.

description.zh: 《数据密集型应用系统设计》。第一遍囫囵吞枣，这一遍老老实实做笔记。
description.en: Designing Data-Intensive Applications. The first pass was a blur; this time I take notes properly.
